The dir="start" attempt (port -> pad) is the one that would work, and it EXHAUSTS in the full run while it succeeds with --only-net => the binding difference is the OTHER NETS COPPER ALONG THE PATH (contention), not a missing or sealed start.
consequence: a solution-layer drawing piece would add copper to a place the R1440 witness shows is already routable, and would not touch the measured cause. The honest next step is one of: (i) let the (out,in) endpoint class use the same dR-port substitution the both-outside class already uses (engine means, already landed for the other class), or (ii) a conservation-level conflict-set read ALONG the port->pad corridor naming the nets whose copper must yield.
